macros.name: setbeamerfont
macros.doc: This command sets or resets certain attributes of the beamer-font ⟨beamer-font name⟩.

macros.name: setbeamerfont*
macros.doc: This command sets or resets certain attributes of the beamer-font ⟨beamer-font name⟩.

macros.name: usebeamerfont
macros.doc: This command changes the current font to the font specified by the ⟨beamer-font name⟩.

macros.name: usebeamerfont*
macros.doc: This command changes the current font to the font specified by the ⟨beamer-font name⟩.
